prompt: I'm about to start a 1-1 with Priya. Take notes.
expect: asks meeting title and attendees; invokes take-notes; on completion proposes routing to knowledge/personnel/priya/ per Repo Map; extracts action items; links attendee; updates SQLite and session-log

prompt: I just dropped a Zoom transcript into team-inbox. Reconcile against my SLT meeting notes.
expect: detects transcript; finds today's SLT notes; invokes resolve-against-transcript; routes to leadership meeting-home folder; asks about transcript disposition; indexes and logs
infers meeting type from notes title/attendees; proposes routing destination using Repo Map; links attendees; extracts action items; saves with date-slug filename; indexes and logs

prompt: I have a transcript but no notes. Generate notes from it.
expect: reads transcript from team-inbox/ or specified path; generates structured notes directly; runs full post-processing pipeline

prompt: What action items came out of my meetings this week?
expect: searches session-log.md for this week's pka-meetings open thread entries; queries search_fts for '- [ ]' in recently-filed meeting notes; surfaces consolidated list with source links

prompt: take-notes isn't installed. File my meeting notes anyway.
expect: detects missing take-notes; reports capture unavailable; proceeds with route-only mode; completes full post-processing pipeline

prompt: I was in a Orion project meeting. Route the notes there.
expect: detects 'Orion' matches active project in Repo Map; asks: project workspace or knowledge base? Does not auto-route to project workspace

prompt: earshot recorded my SLT sync this morning. Reconcile my notes and file them.
expect: finds capture directory via meeting.json marker; matches notes via **Recording**: header or date; reconciles against <capture-dir>/transcript.md before routing; routes only the notes file, leaving the capture directory in place; preserves the **Recording**: header line verbatim; does not ask transcript disposition for capture artifacts

prompt: File my meeting notes from meeting-notes/. There's a recording folder in there too.
expect: detects earshot capture directory by meeting.json; if capture has unreconciled transcript.md, offers Mode 2 reconciliation before routing; never moves the capture directory; if narrative.md exists, indexes it into search_fts and references it in the session-log entry

prompt: File my notes from the sync with Rob and Priya.
expect: resolves names with `pka-tools people resolve`; 'Rob' does not match robin-smith (nicknames are never guessed), so asks who Rob is instead of linking; after the user says 'Rob is Robin Smith', offers `people alias robin-smith "Rob"`; files with post-route so both Priya and Robin get one timeline line

prompt: File these meeting notes. Attendees: Robin, Priya.
expect: when two person folders match 'Robin' (robin-smith, robin-chen), `people resolve` answers ambiguous; asks which Robin; never picks one; Priya is linked and gets a timeline line; Robin is added only after the user answers

prompt: File the notes from today's all-hands. There were about 30 people there.
expect: files the note with post-route; with more than 8 resolved attendees the timeline step adds none of them and the summary says so; does not pass --include-large unless the user asks for everyone's timeline

prompt: File my meeting notes with Jordan, who is new.
expect: people resolve finds no person folder for Jordan; lists Jordan without a link; does not create a person folder; files the note; the timeline step reports nobody (or only existing people) and no folder is created

prompt: File my 1-1 notes with Priya. This workspace isn't an Obsidian vault.
expect: routes to the person's folder as YYYY-MM-DD-1-1-priya.md; post-route skips frontmatter and the MOC bullet (no Obsidian) but adds a timeline line to personnel/priya/index.md with a relative markdown link, kind 1on1, and a topics-only summary
